Blaeu, 1662.; Spanish text on verso: ""Finlandia"", description of Finland and its history.; Title in decorative cartouche with putti and coats of arms of Finland and its provinces: Caiania, Finlandia Meridional, Finlandia, Finlandia Septentrional, Savolaxia, Tavastia, Nylandia, Carelia.; Dedication in decorative cartouche with the Finnish coat of arms of the Horn noble family.
